#
# Module devmgr configuration.
#
configure snmp sysName "X450e-48p"
configure sntp-client primary 192.168.8.150 vr VR-Default
enable sntp-client
#
# Module vlan configuration.
#
configure vlan Default ipaddress 192.168.9.65 255.255.254.0
configure iproute add default 192.168.8.1 vr VR-Default
configure ports 4 display-string camera
configure ports 49 display-string uplink
disable ports 5
#
# Module poe configuration.
#
disable inline-power ports 3
